title: Goldfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd166' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- tail fin, swishing -->
  <path d='M24 50 C14 36 10 30 6 24 C16 28 24 34 30 42 Z' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <path d='M24 54 C12 62 8 70 6 78 C16 72 24 64 30 58 Z' fill='#ffb85c'/>
  <path d='M26 52 C16 48 8 44 4 40 C14 44 22 48 30 50 Z' fill='#ff7a1a'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M40 34 C46 24 54 22 62 26 C56 30 50 34 46 38 Z' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='26' ry='19' fill='#ffb121'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='58' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#ffd166' opacity='0.85'/>

  <path d='M50 46 C44 34 40 28 34 22 C44 26 52 34 56 44 Z' fill='#ff7a1a'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 58 q5 4 9 -1' stroke='#d95f00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M80 22 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#fff4b8'/>
  <path d='M18 88 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 Z' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <path d='M86 74 l1.4 3.4 3.4 1.4 -3.4 1.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 -3.4 -3.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 Z' fill='#fff4b8'/>
